main.description: Update a playlist's metadata. Rewrites the app.rocksky.playlist record in place; only the owner may do so.

uri.description: The URI of the playlist to update

name.description: The new name of the playlist

description.description: The new description of the playlist

pictureUrl.description: The new cover image URL for the playlist

uri.description: The AT-URI of the updated app.rocksky.playlist record.

cid.description: The CID of the updated app.rocksky.playlist record.
